name: openarm
description: OpenArm / Isaac Lab robot-arm control with a big-brain/cerebellum (大脑/小脑) split. Contributes the arm_* agent tools in-process (capability-driven skills discovered at runtime, driven over the SSR event bus with a suspend -> completion-handler -> wake loop) and hosts the cerebellum: a bus handler on arm.grasp.request that grasps via the Om-Agent VLX-Flow streaming vision model (camera RTSP stream in, realtime servo corrections out, arm.grasp.result callback). Configure VLX in ~/.ssr/vlx.json (OM_API_KEY / VLX_RTSP_PULL_URL). The environment side is the ssr-robotics Isaac Lab bridge.

handlers.code:
from ssr.robotics.cerebellum import handle_grasp_event
handle_grasp_event(event, bus, settings)
